description: Creates a snapshot of a DB cluster.

DBClusterSnapshotArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the DB cluster snapshot.

DBClusterSnapshotIdentifier.description: The identifier for the DB cluster snapshot. Must contain from 1 to 63 letters, numbers, or hyphens. First character must be a letter. Can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens.

DBClusterIdentifier.description: The identifier of the DB cluster to create a snapshot for.

Tags.description: The tags to be assigned to the DB cluster snapshot.

AvailabilityZones.description: The list of Availability Zones where instances in the DB cluster snapshot can be restored.

Engine.description: The name of the database engine for this DB cluster snapshot.

EngineVersion.description: The version of the database engine for this DB cluster snapshot.

SnapshotType.description: The type of the DB cluster snapshot.

AllocatedStorage.description: The allocated storage size of the DB cluster snapshot in gibibytes (GiB).

Status.description: The status of this DB cluster snapshot.

Port.description: The port that the DB cluster was listening on at the time of the snapshot.

VpcId.description: The VPC ID associated with the DB cluster snapshot.

ClusterCreateTime.description: The time when the DB cluster was created, in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

MasterUsername.description: The master username for this DB cluster snapshot.

EngineMode.description: The engine mode of the database engine for this DB cluster snapshot.

LicenseModel.description: The license model information for this DB cluster snapshot.

StorageEncrypted.description: Indicates whether the DB cluster snapshot is encrypted.

KmsKeyId.description: If StorageEncrypted is true, the AWS KMS key identifier for the encrypted DB cluster snapshot.

IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled.description: Indicates whether mapping of AWS IAM accounts to database accounts is enabled.

DbClusterResourceId.description: The resource ID of the DB cluster that this DB cluster snapshot was created from.

SnapshotCreateTime.description: The time when the snapshot was taken, in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).

Key.description: The key name of the tag.
